name: MMA Fighters
desc:
🚨 MMA RISE TO CHAMPION — PUBLIC PAID BETA 🚨

THE WAIT IS OVER.

📅 Public Paid Beta opens Monday, September 14.

A brand-new MMA experience built to take combat sports on Roblox to the next level.

What’s new:
🛠️ Overhauled gameplay mechanics
🧲 More immersive gameplay
💥 New combat animations
🥊 New accessories and progression

🎁 EXCLUSIVE PERKS FOR THE FIRST 500 PLAYERS

Join early, step into the cage, master the new combat system and begin your journey to become a Champion. 🏆
These exclusive rewards are limited to the first 500 players and will never be available again.

⚠️ This is still a BETA — the game will continue to evolve with your feedback.

TRAIN. FIGHT. RISE. 👊🔥
